comparison.core_question: Identical across 2023,2024,2025 except question number and layout.
comparison.response_codes: 1=experience,2=no experience in all years. No code reversal or recall-period change found.
comparison.context_2023_to_2024: Definition retains the same substantive description and examples of text,image and video generation; ChatGPT is transliterated as 챗GPT and Bard is replaced by Gemini. The Google screenshot changes from Bard to Gemini. The subsequent service-type follow-up changes categories/examples, but is a separate item after A.
comparison.context_2024_to_2025: Definition and ChatGPT/Gemini example images retained. The Part D heading becomes 생성형 AI 이용 현황 및 인식 and the introductory instruction asking about changes to daily life is omitted. Follow-up item numbering and branching change.
comparison.position: 2023 Q23,2024 Q24,2025 Q20; these are item identifiers, not changes in the response coding.
comparison.interpretive_boundary: Stable core prompt and codes do not establish measurement invariance. Updated examples, altered instrument position/context, sample composition and actual behavior may affect reported experience. The 2025 A measure is not used as a predictor in the two original 2023-to-2024 and2024-to-2025 prediction transitions.

recommended_manuscript_sentence: The generative-AI experience item retained the same question and response codes across waves (1, experience; 2, no experience), with no specified recall window. Its identifier changed from Q23 in 2023 to Q24 in 2024 and Q20 in 2025. The preceding explanatory examples replaced Bard with Gemini in 2024; therefore, the audit supports stable core coding while allowing for changes in respondents’ interpretation of the surrounding material.
